title: Deepfake Detection Fails Humans At 55%
hook: Humans detect convincing deepfakes only 55% of the time.
closing: Seeing a video is no longer enough; verify the source before trusting it.
question: Could you spot a deepfake?

segments.say: Online deepfake videos reached 95,820, flooding platforms faster than people can verify them.
Humans detect deepfakes only 55% of the time, making visual confidence dangerously unreliable.
Generative-AI fraud cost the US 12.3 billion dollars, turning fake media into real financial damage.
